description: P5-B005-B1-R2 self-authored deterministic synthetic calibration fixture (CAL-01..CAL-13, A2-S section 22.1). Not a byte-for-byte reproduction of the A2 private scratchpad calibration, which A2 itself documents as repository-external and non-reproducible (A2 section 16.1). This is a synthetic structural gate that exercises hard-max saturation (deep-review=40, actionable=12), sector-cap overflow in both tiers (DR-CROWD/ACT-CROWD sectors), bear/crisis capacity reduction (actionable=5), degraded-path actionable suppression, all four volatility classes (VOL_NORMAL/VOL_ELEVATED/VOL_RED_FLAG/VOL_UNAVAILABLE), partial dataStatus with null numeric fields, missing and invalid (NaN) prescreenScore, and rank stability under a fixed +/-2 percent perturbation (top-40 Jaccard >= 0.95 with at least one genuine rank swap at the selection boundary). It does NOT claim to represent the statistical distribution of real candidates_stocks.json data -- that production-distribution gate is deferred to B2 (A2-S section 22.2, P-01..P-15). Values were not tuned post-hoc to hit thresholds; group-level fundamentals were chosen analytically from the percentile-rank formula to land in the intended tier bands, then verified by running the engine.
